title: Finite-stage identity certificate
statement: Under sectionwise module identity and integral normalization, a finite-stage identity certificate exists.

proof.text: For each finite coefficient field and integral constructible representative, unfold integralRealizationAgreement at the identity isomorphism. The specified finite comparison formula, sectionwise module identity, and cancellation of the finite-stage and localization isomorphisms give the displayed equation.

theorem normalized_reindexing_identity_finite
    (C : FamilyCore l D)
    (h_moduleId_sections : ∀ (T : GeometricSpace D) (M : modules l T.base.left (C.data
      T).realization)
          (U : T.base.left.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (x : ((modulePull l T.base.left (𝟙 _) (C.ring T T (Iso.refl _))).obj M).val.obj U),
        HEq (((C.moduleId T).hom.app M).val.app U x) x)
    (h_integral_normalization : ∀ (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
          (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l)),
        letI := (C.data T).units
        letI := (C.data U).units
        integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (C.data T).realization (C.data U).realization
          (C.ring T U g) E (C.integral T U g E) (C.comparison T U g)) :
    Nonempty (NormalizedReindexingFiniteCertificate l D C)
